overview_description.description: Avocademy provides an education platform aimed at training professionals in UX/UI design. Through an eight-week curriculum, the company platform provides consumers with affordable and personalized UX/UI programs, as well as other services such as mentoring, allowing them to build careers in the digital arts field efficiently.

product.name: UX/UI Design Career Accelerator
product.description: A structured program teaching foundational and advanced UX/UI design skills, including AI product design, portfolio building, and career services to prepare students for UX roles.

identifier.value: UX/UI Design for AI Products Program

product.name: UX/UI Design for AI Products Program
product.description: A curriculum focused on UX/UI design principles and practices specifically for AI-driven products, including user research, ideation, design, and usability testing.

product.name: Career Services
product.description: Support services including portfolio development, resume optimization, interview preparation, job search guidance, and mentorship to assist graduates in securing UX/UI design roles.

product.name: Intro to UX/UI Course
product.description: An introductory course covering the basics of UX and UI design, including design thinking, research methods, and design tools.
